Title: Verify successful registration redirects to confirmation page
Description: AC-2: After submit user is taken to confirmation page
Test Action: Navigate to /register and log in as Operator
Fill all required fields with valid data and click Submit

Step Expected: Confirmation page displays 'Your registration has been submitted'

Title: Verify failed registration keeps user on form with error message
Description: AC-3: API error preserves form data
Test Action: Navigate to /register and log in as Operator
Fill all fields with valid data
Click Submit while the API is configured to return a 500 error (use test flag ?simulate_error=true)

Step Expected: Red error banner displays 'Registration could not be saved — please try again'
All previously entered field values are preserved in the form
